source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
On cards, a unit leaving the battlefield means it:

- is **destroyed**
- goes aboard a **TRANSPORT**
- is removed by a rule, such as to put it into **[strategic reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)**

qualifyingEvents: the unit embarks on a TRANSPORT
any rule removes the unit from the battlefield
detail.example: removal to place the unit in strategic reserves
